description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named LocationEmployeeCount used within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin, representing the employee count associated with a specific location.

classes.name: LocationEmployeeCount
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating location ID, location name, and employee count for dashboard reporting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with location ID, name, and employee count.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the location.

methods.name: getLocationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the location.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of employees in the location.
